ipos.prose:
As of today, the Orient Cables IPO grey market premium is ₹113 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹100 and ₹116. That is ₹53 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹272 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 41.54%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.32× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (66/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Orient Cables IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Orient Cables IPO subscription status and Orient Cables IPO allotment status. This Orient Cables IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Orient Cables IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Orient Cables IPO is subscribed 0.32 times overall so far. It is not yet fully subscribed; the figure moves until the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Orient Cables IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Orient Cables IPO bidding window is 25-29 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Orient Cables IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Orient Cables IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Orient Cables IPO is expected on 30 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Orient Cables IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Orient Cables IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Orient Cables IPO is subscribed 0.32 times overall. It is not oversubscribed on that figure, so valid applications are generally allotted in full.

faq.a: As of 25 Sep 2026, 11:46 AM IST, the median GMP of Moneyview IPO across 5 public tracker(s) is ₹14, with individual trackers quoting between ₹14 and ₹16. That implies an estimated listing gain of about 41.18% — an unofficial market signal, not a guarantee.

faq.q: What listing gain does the GMP suggest for Moneyview IPO?
faq.a: Against the upper price band of ₹34, today's median GMP of ₹14 implies an estimated listing gain of roughly 41.18%. This is a sentiment reading derived from unofficial grey-market quotes — our public accuracy audit shows GMP frequently over-promises, so treat it as an expectation gauge, not a forecast.

faq.q: Is the GMP reliable for Moneyview IPO?
faq.a: Our confidence grade for Moneyview's GMP is high (70/100), computed from tracker coverage (92/100), cross-tracker agreement (71/100) and day-to-day stability (25/100). faq.a: The registrar for Moneyview IPO is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. The registrar processes applications and finalises the basis of allotment, and its website is where allotment status is checked once results are published.

ipos.prose:
The Moneyview IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹14 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹14 to ₹16. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹34 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 41.18%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.01× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (70/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Moneyview IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Moneyview IPO subscription status and Moneyview IPO allotment status. This Moneyview IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Moneyview IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Moneyview IPO is subscribed 2.01 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Moneyview IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Moneyview IPO bidding window is 24-28 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Moneyview IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Moneyview IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Moneyview IPO is expected on 29 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Moneyview IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Moneyview IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Moneyview IPO is subscribed 2.01 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Adroit Industries IPO at a median premium of ₹33 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹28 to ₹37. That is ₹1 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Trackers differ by about 27.3% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹134 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 24.63%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 26.87× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (76/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Adroit Industries IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Adroit Industries IPO subscription status and Adroit Industries IPO allotment status. This Adroit Industries IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Adroit Industries IPO subscribed?

The A-One Steels IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹49 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹35 to ₹52. That is ₹4 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 34.7% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹405 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 12.1%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.58× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (70/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The A-One Steels IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also A-One Steels IPO subscription status and A-One Steels IPO allotment status. This A-One Steels IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Runwal Enterprises IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹25 today, drawn from 5 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹23 to ₹37. The median has slipped ₹10 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 56% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹305 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 8.2%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.03× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (57/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Runwal Enterprises IPO subscription status and Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment status. This Runwal Enterprises IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Acevector IPO grey market premium is ₹2 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹2 and ₹3. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 50% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹32 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 6.25%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.02× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (60/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Acevector IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Acevector IPO subscription status and Acevector IPO allotment status. This Acevector IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Acevector IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Acevector IPO is subscribed 0.02 times overall so far. It is not yet fully subscribed; the figure moves until the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Acevector IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Acevector IPO bidding window is 25-29 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Acevector IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Acevector IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Acevector IPO is expected on 30 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Acevector IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Acevector IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Acevector IPO is subscribed 0.02 times overall. It is not oversubscribed on that figure, so valid applications are generally allotted in full.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the ArMee Infotech IPO at a median premium of ₹20 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹7 to ₹56. That is ₹1.5 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 245% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹375 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 5.33%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.98× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (56/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The ArMee Infotech IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also ArMee Infotech IPO subscription status and ArMee Infotech IPO allotment status. This ArMee Infotech IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Swastika Infra IPO at a median premium of ₹7.75 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹6 to ₹9. That is ₹0.8 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 38.7% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹185 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 4.19%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.79× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (23-25 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (64/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Swastika Infra IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Swastika Infra IPO subscription status and Swastika Infra IPO allotment status. This Swastika Infra IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Swastika Infra IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Swastika Infra IPO is subscribed 1.79 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.a: The Swastika Infra IPO bidding window is 23-25 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Swastika Infra IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.a: The Swastika Infra IPO is subscribed 1.79 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the SRIT India IPO grey market premium is ₹21 at the median of 5 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹14 and ₹22. The median has climbed ₹8 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 38.1% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹130 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 16.15%; treat it as expectation, not promise. The issue is upcoming, with dates listed as 28-30 Sep; every open and upcoming issue is on the IPO calendar. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (55/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. This SRIT India IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

₹116 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड के मुक़ाबले यह प्रीमियम लगभग 3.45% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है — यह बाज़ार की उम्मीद है, कोई भविष्यवाणी नहीं। माँग की तरफ़ देखें तो यह इश्यू कुल 17.72 गुना सब्सक्राइब हो चुका है। बोली बंद हो चुकी है; अब प्रीमियम अलॉटमेंट और लिस्टिंग की उम्मीदों पर चल रहा है। FX Multitech आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ 24 Sep है। यह एक एसएमई इश्यू है, इसलिए सावधानी ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है: एसएमई का ग्रे मार्केट पतला होता है, हमारे आँकड़ों में ट्रैकरों का मतभेद यहीं सबसे ज़्यादा रहता है, और छोटे बाज़ार को प्रभावित करना आसान होता है।

faq_hi.q: FX Multitech आईपीओ का जीएमपी आज क्या है?
faq_hi.a: 25 Sep 2026, 11:46 AM IST तक FX Multitech आईपीओ का जीएमपी 4 सार्वजनिक ट्रैकरों के औसत पर ₹4 है, और अलग-अलग ट्रैकर ₹3 से ₹4 के बीच भाव दे रहे हैं।

faq_hi.q: FX Multitech आईपीओ से कितना लिस्टिंग लाभ मिल सकता है?
faq_hi.a: ₹116 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड पर आज का औसत जीएमपी लगभग 3.45% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है। यह अनौपचारिक ग्रे मार्केट भावों से निकला संकेत है, कोई गारंटी नहीं।

faq_hi.q: FX Multitech आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ क्या है?
faq_hi.a: FX Multitech आईपीओ का बेसिस ऑफ़ अलॉटमेंट 24 Sep को तय होना है। अलॉटमेंट की स्थिति रजिस्ट्रार और एक्सचेंज उसी दिन प्रकाशित करते हैं।

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the FX Multitech IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The FX Multitech IPO is subscribed 17.72 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the FX Multitech IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The FX Multitech IPO bidding window is 21-23 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get FX Multitech IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the FX Multitech IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the FX Multitech IPO is expected on 24 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check FX Multitech IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the FX Multitech IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The FX Multitech IPO is subscribed 17.72 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.
